mechanics_notes: 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. The user creates two Destructo-Discs and throws them individually in a pincer pattern. The discs track the opponent and are unblockable; current skill-specific documentation reports 30% total damage across the two hits. It is taught by Android 18, and current character data also lists it on Android 18's Skirt Style 2 and Android 18 (DB Super). Exact tracking strength and frame data remain unresolved.
